narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the current crisis facing the Florida orange juice industry, citing shifting consumer health perceptions and the devastating 'citrus greening' disease. It synthesizes visual data on crop damage and economic policy (tariffs) to explain why the industry is shrinking and invites audience engagement regarding their own breakfast habits.
